_metadata.description: Percentages are index weights for the seven requested constituents, not their own free-float shares. Index weights use free-float methodology. The engine normalizes only these seven selected constituents to calculate a partial-basket flow; they do not sum to 100% of either full index.
_metadata.note: NIFTY snapshot from 29 Oct 2026; SENSEX snapshot from a third-party index-composition table on 29 Oct 2026. Cross-check latest official NSE Indices and BSE Indices factsheets before research conclusions or live trading.
